leads.claim: A radio broadcast reported the crash of a large metal sphere containing a deceased occupant in Conde, Bahia, Brazil.
leads.why: The document reports on a third-party media broadcast rather than providing evidence of government custody or verification of the event.
leads.government_response: Documented as an excerpt in the files of Edward C. Welsh.
leads.quote: alleged crash of a “large metal sphere” containing a deceased occupant

doc_verdict: The document contains a report of a foreign media claim regarding a crash but provides no evidence that the U.S. government obtained or held any material.
